You are the planning module of a tabletop robot. Task specification: The robot must first ensure the green pen case is empty. Then, pick up the yellow pen, rotate it so that it aligns with the long side of the green pen case, and carefully lower it into the case while maintaining this alignment. Success is confirmed when the yellow pen is fully inside the green pen case and oriented parallel to its long side, with no part of the pen extending beyond the case or obstructing its closure.
Goals: [{"object": "yellow_pen", "zone": "green_case"}]

{"table_z": 0.8, "objects": {"yellow_pen": {"kind": "pen", "center": [-0.0088, 0.2112, 0.8059], "top_z": 0.8119, "height": 0.0119, "footprint_long": 0.1389, "footprint_short": 0.0108, "long_axis_yaw": -0.53}}, "zones": {"green_case": {"name": "green_case", "center": [-0.0823, 0.0163, 0.8], "half_size": [0.0763, 0.0223], "long_axis_yaw": 0.96}}, "gripper": {"width": 0.0795, "closed_command": false, "holding_something": false}, "end_effector": {"position": [-0.1974, 0.0001, 1.0801], "yaw": 1.602}}

object to its own destination). Skip objects that are already resting on their target zone.
